entries.0e4ad9cb7c6624ed: A food ingredient manufacturer that produces and sells food emulsifiers and stabilizers, processed egg products, functional food materials and more.
entries.108dd847ce4ff40f: This segment manufactures and sells quality improvers such as emulsifiers. It sells to the dairy, beverage, confectionery, bakery and processed oil and fat industries, as well as to the cosmetics and toiletries industries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥14,102 million.
entries.12d035d2022b233b: Its strength is the technical know-how in food ingredients accumulated since its founding in 1946. In 1952 it developed Japan’s first emulsifier for food, and has since expanded its product range to functional ingredients such as green tea extract and dietary fiber. It also has production sites in China and India, a network of sales subsidiaries in the US, Europe and Asia, and a quality control system based on SQF and FSSC22000 certification.
entries.18b0bd46b6fae01b: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥52,484 million. By segment, the Natural Ingredients Business was ¥21,083 million, the Nutrition Business ¥17,146 million, the Interface Solutions Business ¥14,102 million, and Other ¥151 million.
